acceptanceCriteria: A forged duplicate request with a null recorded pre-state is refused on the read checkpoint with JOURNAL_FORKED.
A maintained test fails without the fix and passes with it.
body: Residual from the journal-1021s lane (PR #1508, V1-0917, PSR-V0-190). The read checkpoint now refuses a duplicate request whose recorded pre-state it does not retain (JOURNAL_FORKED), but a forged duplicate whose recorded pre-state is null still passes reads and is caught only by the writer and complete routes. Expected: reads refuse it with the same code. Actual: reads accept it.
title: Read checkpoint: a forged duplicate request with a null recorded pre-state is caught only on writer/complete routes (PSR-V0-190 residual)
